title: Higher Minimum Quality Standards and Redistributive Effects on Consumer Welfare
authors: Marco J.W. Kotschedoff; Max J. Pachali
eligible_reason: Structural hierarchical Bayesian multinomial logit demand model for eggs (German household scanner data) used to evaluate the welfare effects of the battery-cage egg ban, a single national policy change; no staggered binary treatment and no DiD regression in the package.
design_notes: HigherMQSandCW_FinalReplication_5000draws.R estimates rhierMnlRwMixture-type demand with seasonality controls, computes WTP, regresses WTP draws on demographics (Table 11) and runs supply-side counterfactuals.
data_files_note: readme.txt: original data belong to Nielsen (Germany) under NDA; package ships 'a synthetic/disguised data set' with added noise; data preparation code not included.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
